The '''Main Prisoner Transfer''' was the main roadway that ran along the southern side of the [[Maximum Security Section]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The [[Isolation Area]] and the [[Imperial frontline camp]] were both located off of the road.
